name: dataset_service.py
summary: Orchestrates dataset business logic and coordinates between repository, file, and schema services.
purpose: Encapsulates domain operations for datasets, decoupling business rules from data access and presentation layers while coordinating file handling and schema management.
responsibilities: Orchestrating dataset lifecycle operations such as creation, retrieval, update, and deletion
Coordinating file storage and retrieval through FileService
Managing dataset schema definitions and validation through SchemaService
Enforcing business rules and domain constraints for datasets
Abstracting persistence details by delegating data access to DatasetRepository
outputs: Validation errors and business rule exceptions
architecture_notes: Implements the Service Layer pattern within a Django application, composing a Repository (DatasetRepository) and sibling services (FileService, SchemaService) to isolate business logic from infrastructure concerns. The module-level imports of concrete classes indicate tight coupling; the service acts as a facade that coordinates cross-cutting concerns (file I/O and schema management) but currently lacks explicit dependency injection or abstract interfaces.
improvements: Introduce an abstract interface or ABC for DatasetService to enable loose coupling and easier unit testing
Inject DatasetRepository, FileService, and SchemaService via constructor rather than relying on module-level imports
Add explicit transaction boundaries using Django's @transaction.atomic for multi-service operations
Add structured logging, metrics, and exception handling for observability
Add type hints and input/output DTOs to formalize service contracts
Evaluate adherence to the Single Responsibility Principle; consider splitting pure business logic from cross-service orchestration if the class grows
